name: eurohop-flight-planner
description: Search budget flights across Europe's secondary airports. Expands a city or region into every airport in range, then compares routes and full daily timetables using public Ryanair FareFinder data.

default_currency.title: Default currency
default_currency.description: ISO currency code used to price fares when a search does not name one.

default_origin.title: Home airport or city
default_origin.description: Optional. Used as the departure point when a search does not name one, e.g. CRL, STN, Dublin.

default_radius_km.title: Default search radius (km)
default_radius_km.description: How far from a named city or region to look for alternative airports.
